name: qfd_c_ring516-r0-COMMIT
purpose: CB16 hardened landing ring tile W=516 (x12 in the CB16 parent)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_c_ring516 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/qcluster/qfd_c_land_k.sv rtl/physical/qcluster/qfd_c_ring_t.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_ring516/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_ring516/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_ring516 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_c_ring516  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: QW-CB16REG 10-20 main line (a): the CB16 parent's region crossings are hardened as ONE tile per crossing (writer ring qfd_c_land_w1k on the source region clock ck_w + reader qfd_c_land_r1k on the destination region clock ck_r, W=516, D 4, K 2; 69 instances in the parent, 2 masters).  Why: fulln/fullnb/fullm (flat soft rings) gave each region root 6.7k-20.9k ring flops over 1-2 mm -> within-region TT spread 410-813 ps, WNS -1.4..-1.7 ns at the readers after 10-16 h.  Here each tile clock has its own short tree, the bank -> reader path never leaves the tile, and the parent region clock sees one clock pin per ring.  Same function / epochs / latency as the soft pair (0 added cycles).
